hero.headline: Every stage of a song's life, on one system.
hero.subhead: Six capabilities, from the first file in the data room to every writer payment years after close. Know the songs, buy well, then grow what they earn.

items.title: Every file in the data room, read in minutes.
items.description: Debaser reads PRO statements, mechanical statements, sync deals, sub-publishing agreements, split sheets and cue sheets, in whatever format the seller sends, and turns them into one clean record of the songs.
bullets: PDF, CSV, XLSX and portal exports handled automatically
Statements reconciled against each other across sources
Every song, writer and split extracted and linked
Full ingestion trail kept for the data room

items.title: One clear picture of every song, split and territory.
items.description: Debaser resolves writer and publisher shares, PRO affiliations, sub-publishing chains and collection routes into a single model of who owns each song, and where it earns.
bullets: Writer and publisher splits normalised to 100%
Territory and PRO collection chains mapped end to end
Counterparties matched across every agreement
Conflicts and overlapping claims flagged for review

items.title: Know what the songs earn, and where they can earn more.
items.description: Debaser models earnings history, how each song is ageing, revenue concentration and forecast cash flow, then shows both a fair price and the upside a better-run catalogue would unlock.
bullets: Net earnings history normalised across every source
Ageing and concentration measured song by song
Forecast cash flow with sync roll-off modelled
Offer range and growth case, with the evidence behind them

items.title: Every gap found before you commit.
items.description: Debaser surfaces the things that change the price and the plan: unregistered songs, missing ISWC and CWR data, expired deals, and splits that never matched the paperwork.
bullets: Unregistered and mis-registered songs, by territory
Missing or broken ISWC and CWR metadata
Expired or reverted sub-publishing agreements
Split disputes and undocumented shares

items.title: The same songs, earning more each year.
items.description: After close, Debaser keeps comparing what the catalogue should earn against what it collects, then closes the gap: recovering unclaimed income, filing registrations that were never made, and chasing new sync and licensing.
bullets: Black-box and unclaimed royalty recovery
Re-registration filed where songs were missed
Metadata fixed at the source, not patched over
Sync and licensing opportunities surfaced and pursued

items.title: Every writer paid right, from the day you close.
items.description: Debaser calculates mechanical, performance and sync income, pays every co-writer and collaborator on schedule, and keeps the record current as the songs keep earning.
bullets: Clear statements and payments for every co-writer
Recoupment and advance tracking per deal
Ownership transfer and PRO re-registration handled
Continuous monitoring against the case you bought on

cta.headline: Ready to see it on a real catalogue?
cta.subhead: Share the seller's data. We'll hand back a full read on the songs, the earnings and the upside.
